title: Practice 3: This week, next month, last year

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: Катали ли вы яйца на ___ (святая неделя)?
exercises.why: «на» + prepositional. From Лев Толстой, «История вчерашнего дня».
«в» + prepositional. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
Seasons and parts of the day with этот, прошлый, следующий: instrumental — этим летом, прошлой зимой. From Михаил Булгаков, «Морфий».
«на» + prepositional. From Юрий Тынянов, «Кюхля».
